sig: [[["A", "Good afternoon, everyone, and thank you for joining this town hall, both here in London and online."], ["A", "I'll get straight to the point. This morning, our board approved a merger with Brightline Analytics."], ["A", "Many of you know Brightline; they're based in Manchester and they're one of the strongest data analytics firms in the country."], ["A", "Together, we'll have around two thousand employees and offices in five countries."], ["A", "I want to be clear about one thing: this is about growth, not cost-cutting."], ["A", "We are not planning any layoffs as part of this deal."], ["A", "The merger is expected to close by the end of March, pending regulatory approval."], ["A", "Until then, it's business as usual. Please keep serving your clients exactly as you do today."], ["A", "I also know news travels fast, so please don't discuss the deal with clients or the press until our public announcement on Thursday."], ["A", "Your managers will hold team meetings tomorrow to answer your questions in more detail."], ["A", "And of course, my door is always open."]], {"A": "M-GB"}]
